#codex-reply
Addressed https://github.com/tekkura/sr-android/pull/325#pullrequestreview-5166424574 in b7f2ba7ea7fef291c85cd0ecb64f9cbd63515aa9.

The version handshake now waits for a real GET_VERSION response instead of letting an unrelated queued ACK/status/log satisfy the startup receive path, with regression coverage for stale data before the version response. MockRP2040 now returns a supported three-byte GET_VERSION response, so virtual firmware tests exercise the documented version protocol.
